Share on X Telegram Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid beat Sevilla 4-1 to remain six points behind La Liga leaders Barcelona ahead of next weekend’s El Clasico.
Arda Guler opened the scoring in the 30th minute with a superb strike before Mbappe doubled Real Madrid’s lead seven minutes later, rounding Sevilla goalkeeper Odysseas Vlachodimos and slotting the ball into the net.
Sevilla attempted to fight back after the break, with Felix Correia’s volley bouncing off the ground and deflecting just over the crossbar.
However, Real Madrid strengthened their advantage when Mbappe was brought down inside the penalty area and the France forward converted the resulting spot-kick to register his 11th goal of the season.
The 26-year-old has now scored 11 goals in 11 appearances across all competitions, underlining his importance to Real Madrid’s attacking campaign.
Sevilla managed a late consolation through Manu Bueno, who curled a fine finish into the bottom corner, but Real Madrid maintained control to secure all three points.
The victory provides a timely boost for Real Madrid ahead of their next La Liga fixture against Barcelona on 25 October.
With the gap at the top remaining six points, the forthcoming El Clasico presents Real Madrid with an opportunity to reduce Barcelona’s advantage in the title race.
